name: Duplicant
oracle_text:
Imprint — When this creature enters, you may exile target nontoken creature.
As long as a card exiled with this creature is a creature card, this creature has the power, toughness, and creature types of the last creature card exiled with it. It's still a Shapeshifter.
blocked_sentences: As long as a card exiled with this creature is a creature card, this creature has the power, toughness, and creature types of the last creature card exiled with it. It's still a Shapeshifter.

needs.what: a static on the source whose base power and toughness are the printed power/toughness of the last creature card exiled with it (an `exiled_with: self` card, most recent first), active only while such a card exists in exile
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `set_pt` static takes its power/toughness from `static_value_keys`, which has no `power_of`/`toughness_of` or other reader of a card in exile; `static_condition_keys` `exists` cannot be confirmed to accept `exiled_with`, and nothing selects the LAST card exiled with the source

needs.what: a static that sets the source's creature types to the creature types of the last creature card exiled with it, keeping Shapeshifter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_subtype` (static and op) adds a fixed printed list of subtypes; there is no way to copy subtypes from another object, and `become_copy` copies every characteristic, not just P/T and creature types
